subject: Marketplace onboarding: private-offer path and timing
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cielux.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Marketplace onboarding: private-offer path and timing

Alex — thanks again for the demo yesterday. We outlined a tight runway to get Cielux onto the AWS private offer path and into production by early May. To keep things simple I put together a short mutual action plan (MAP) we can use to track owners and dates.

High-level suggested milestones (proposed):
- 4/23: we deliver MAP + private-offer checklist and draft PO terms (you confirm procurement contact & AWS account ID)
- 4/26: Cielux confirms billing preference (monthly via Marketplace vs net-30 invoice) and returns PO/approval
- 4/28: countersign / DocuSign execution
- 4/30–5/01: Redwood requests AWS private offer; AWS issues private offer to your account (typical 24–48 hrs)
- 5/03: service enabled and first billing cycle begins

Quick asks from our side: please confirm procurement@cielux.health is the right distribution list, provide the AWS account ID you want the offer attached to, and flag any internal approval milestones we should know about. If you need a different cadence, tell us and we’ll adjust the MAP.

I’m attaching a lightweight MAP so we can populate owners; Ben (cc) will drive the private-offer logistics on our end.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Attachments: Redwood-Cielux-MAP-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet outline)

From: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cielux.health>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@cielux.health>
Date: 2027-04-23T10:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Marketplace onboarding: private-offer path and timing

Thanks Sofia — appreciate the clear milestones. A few quick items from procurement:
- We do prefer AWS Private Offer via the AWS Marketplace so bill flows through our Marketplace account.
- Procurement will need a draft PO and the contract summary (SaaS T&Cs + order form) for review; please include a sample invoice layout so we can validate GL codes.
- Our target close date is COB 2027-05-06 (end of quarter for us) — can you confirm the fastest path to issuance once documents are signed?

I’m looping in procurement@cielux.health — please chase them for the AWS account ID if they don’t supply it.

—Alex
Alex Moreno
VP of Platform Engineering, Cielux Health
alex.moreno@cielux.health
Office: +1 415 555 0192

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-23T12:30:00-07:00
Subject: internal: CLX MAP tasks (do not share)

Sofia / Marissa — quick internal checklist based on Alex’s ask: 
- Marissa: legal to review order form + any PO language (target 4/25)
- Finance: generate sample invoice layout and confirm GL mapping (target 4/24) — I will own sending the draft PO
- DevOps/Product: confirm SSO/SCIM date and production enablement window (Marissa, can you kick off?)
- Operations: estimate private-offer request lead time — historically 24–48 hrs after DocuSign

I’ll prep the PO-draft and the private-offer checklist this afternoon and attach to the MAP.

Ben Carter
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cielux.health>, Procurement Team <procurement@cielux.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-24T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: MAP + private-offer checklist (Redwood <> Cielux)

Alex / Procurement team — attached are the MAP and a short private-offer checklist. Key callouts: 
- We will issue a standard SaaS order form for signature (DocuSign link below). Once signed, Redwood requests the AWS Private Offer be created and associated with the AWS account ID you provide.
- Typical timing: DocuSign signature → Redwood files private-offer request with AWS (we do this same business day) → AWS issues offer to your account within 24–48 hours.
- Billing options: (1) Monthly Marketplace billing (recommended for continuity) or (2) Redwood invoices net-30 to Cielux and we handle settlement outside the marketplace — indicate preference on the MAP.

Proposed MAP milestones (please review & mark owners):
- 4/24: Cielux confirms billing preference + provides AWS account ID
- 4/25: Legal review complete (Cielux) / Redwood sends final PO-draft
- 4/27: DocuSign execution
- 4/29: AWS private offer accepted by Cielux account
- 5/03: Production access enabled

Attachments: Redwood-Cielux-MAP-v1.xlsx, Redwood-PrivateOffer-Checklist.pdf, PO-draft-Cielux-20270506.pdf

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/CLX-PO-DRAFT-2027
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Cell: +1 650 555 0144

From: Procurement Team <procurement@cielux.health>

Cc: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cielux.health>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-26T15:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP + private-offer checklist (Redwood <> Cielux)

Sofia / Ben — thanks for the materials. Answers below: 
- AWS account ID for offer attachment: 987654321012
- We prefer Marketplace monthly billing (please include sample Marketplace invoice format).
- Billing address for our AP team:
  Cielux Health, Accounts Payable
  400 Civic Center Dr, Suite 100
  Palo Alto, CA 94301
- Regarding commitment: procurement is prepared to issue a PO once the order form/terms are final. We need the PO to reference the exact SKU and term.
- Can you confirm Redwood’s internal contact for any post-acceptance onboarding issues?

Procurement Team
procurement@cielux.health

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Alex Moreno <alex.moreno@cielux.health>, Procurement Team <procurement@cielux.health>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:00:00-07:00
Subject: Final MAP & next steps — target sign by 5/06

Team — thanks for the quick turnaround. We’re aligned on the path. Final confirm:
- AWS account ID received (987654321012).
- Billing: monthly Marketplace billing — Redwood will provide a sample Marketplace invoice layout (attached).
- Next steps we will execute:
  1) Redwood to upload final order form to DocuSign today (please review and sign by 2027-05-06 to meet your Q2 close)
  2) Upon signature we will request the AWS Private Offer be issued to account 987654321012 (expected 24–48 hrs)
  3) Finance/Operations will confirm first billing date and send sample invoice for your AP team
  4) Post-acceptance onboarding: Marissa will own SSO/production enablement and will reach out with a short kickoff once the offer is accepted.

Attachments: PO-draft-Cielux-20270506.pdf, Redwood-Cielux-MAP-v1.xlsx

If that timeline works, we’ll proceed with DocuSign and keep a tight cadence to hit 5/06.

Best —
Sofia Ivanova
Sr. Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
Attachments: PO-draft-Cielux-20270506.pdf (draft), Redwood-Cielux-MAP-v1.xlsx (filled with owners)
